parameters.description:
`msg-to-dapnet` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your DAPNET destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own DAPNET destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional DAPNET destinations bound per enrollment.

DAPNET (Hampager) paging is only available to licensed ham radio operators. Sign up for an account at hampager.de, then set DAPNET_CALLSIGN to the callsign of the pager you want to reach (optionally with a -N suffix for a specific sub-receiver), and DAPNET_TRANSMITTER_GROUP to the transmitter group that should carry the page — see hampager.de/#/transmitters/groups for the group names available in your area.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment DAPNET destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to DAPNET calls API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own DAPNET destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's DAPNET_BASIC value (same format as DAPNET_BASIC)

callsign_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's DAPNET_CALLSIGN value (same format as DAPNET_CALLSIGN)

transmitter_group_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's DAPNET_TRANSMITTER_GROUP value (same format as DAPNET_TRANSMITTER_GROUP)
